title: Vietnamese-Style Chicken Pho with Ginger and Star Anise
summary: A fragrant dairy-free chicken noodle soup inspired by Vietnamese pho, with ginger, cinnamon and star-anise-style warmth. It is light but satisfying for dinner, with tender chicken, rice noodles and fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: star anise style spice substitute, fennel seeds

steps: Put the chicken stock, ginger, halved onion, garlic, cinnamon, fennel seeds and ground coriander in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer for 10 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken thighs to the broth. Simmer gently for 18–22 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and tender with no pink in the centre.

Lift the chicken onto a board. Strain the broth through a sieve into a clean pan, discarding the aromatics. Stir in the fish sauce, brown sugar, salt and black pepper, then keep the broth hot over a low heat.
Shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces using two forks. Return it to the hot broth for 2–3 minutes to warm through and soak up the flavour.
Cook the rice noodles according to the packet instructions, usually soaking or simmering for 4–6 minutes until tender but still slightly springy. Drain and divide between four deep bowls.
Ladle the hot broth and shredded chicken over the noodles. Top with bean sprouts, spring onions, coriander, mint and chilli.
Serve immediately with lime wedges for squeezing over the soup.
